title: Episode 6
summary: Mervin is tied up by his brother in the same room as the murder victim
method: There was no murder. Soloman thought he shot the smoothie shop owner but it was blanks and a fake blood pack. The plan was to fake his death and frame Soloman
motive: It was staged to trick Soloman and frame him for murder.
notes: The guy who tried to take Selwyn's job last season makes an appearance. The episode is set in Antigua
